stem: Based on the events that take place at the end of the play, what will Jude most likely do next?

options.label: A
options.text: Jude will ask his mom to buy him a new camera.

options.label: B
options.text: Jude will use the camera to make a movie with Grandpa Sam.

options.label: C
options.text: Jude will show his mom how to put film in an old camera.

options.label: D
options.text: Jude will take Grandpa Sam to a store that sells modern cameras and film.
